title: Breast Cancer Detection — ML Comparative Analysis
summary: A comparative machine-learning study for breast cancer detection, paired with a public-perception survey, referencing NIRAMAI Thermalytix as an industry benchmark.
highlights: Dataset — UCI Wisconsin Breast Cancer dataset (n = 569)
Models compared — Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, KNN
Complementary study — Public perception survey (n = 54) on early detection and ML-based screening
Guide — Mr. Ranjith Sharma R, Assistant Professor, Rathinam School of Business
note: Full results and model-comparison metrics will be added once the thesis is finalized.

title: District Health Indicators Dashboard
summary: A district-level health indicators dashboard built on NHM Karnataka HMIS-style data, designed around a Store → Process → Visualise → Present workflow.
highlights: Excel for structuring, SQL for querying, Tableau / Power BI for visualization
Focus: district-level HMIS indicator tracking and reporting
